next_by_reading.utwf_strongest: the supervisor brings two questions to the user before group 6: uTWF into roster v3 (the strongest-policy rule), and whether step 2's frozen base becomes uTWF's logits (or uTWF's level a phi feature)

rules.floor: per comparison and world (D3): floor_w = max(atlas noise_floor, 3 SE of the run's own paired differences), the own SE only with >= 2 paired observations (the n = 1 rule)
rules.mean_floor_alternative: reported only: the mean difference against max(mean atlas floor, 3 SE of the per-world differences)
rules.means: per world: equal-weight mean over episodes of the replicate means
rules.pairing: uTWF - MWWk / uTWF - TS: per episode, replicate by replicate (the same keys); uTWF - RR: each uTWF replicate against RR's one row
rules.reading: 12 producers decide (42 reported): utwf_strongest when uTWF - RR and uTWF - MWWk both exceed their per-comparison floor on the 23-world loaded mean, i.e. mean_w(X_w) > mean_w(floor_w) for each comparison X, AND uTWF loses to RR (RR_w - uTWF_w > floor_w) on <= 1/6 of the worlds (6 n <= worlds, exact); utwf_not_better otherwise
rules.reference: RR, MWWk and TS are EXP-0057's recorded rows (episodes.csv SHA-256 registered); the reproduced RR row of every world-episode must equal EXP-0057's (exp0057_neutrality), and every row's digests must equal EXP-0057's
